title: Functional food formulation by incorporating the encapsulated extract of Phlogacanthus thyrsiflorus flower

Phlogacanthus thyrsiflorus flower (locally known as Nongmangkha), an underutilized medicinal flower, is a rich source of polyphenols with reported antioxidant, hypoglycemic, and hepatoprotective activities.
